trips.name: Santa Fe Springs Celebration
trips.route: Ichetucknee Springs Campground to Bowman's Landing
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks and shuttle. Optional cabins at Bowman's Landing (Nov 6 and 7) cost extra.
trips.note: An extra day was added for the 100th trip.
trips.blurb: Come celebrate one of Florida’s prettiest rivers, called “Holy Faith” by the Spanish, which lives up to its name with its quiet beauty. The Santa Fe boasts dozens of significant springs, including the celebrated paddleable Santa Fe tributary, the Ichetucknee River.

trips.name: Florida Keys Challenge
trips.route: Six days of paddling from the Seacamp basecamp, with easy, mid and long routes each day
trips.note: Routes include Picnic Island, Coupon Bight, Little Torch Key, Bahia Honda State Park and Ramrod Key.
trips.blurb: Join us for a cold weather escape as we paddle the Florida Keys and explore some of the most beautiful turquoise waters in the State of Florida! This year’s trip includes both short and long paddling options, from our basecamp each day, and an educational component provided by Newfound Harbor Marine Institute.

trips.name: Blackwater River + Coldwater Creek Experience
trips.route: Blackwater Joe's in Harold to Carpenter's Park in Milton
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, river maps and evening programs. Cabins at Blackwater Joe's are optional and extra.
trips.blurb: The Blackwater River and Coldwater Creek, its major tributary in Florida, particularly within Blackwater River State Park, is known for its unique contrast of dark, tannic water with pristine, white sandy beaches and large sandbars. Join us as we explore these riverways and Blackwater River State Forest close to Pensacola!

trips.name: Suwannee River Paddling Festival
trips.route: Madison Blue Spring State Park down the Withlacoochee to the Suwannee, ending at Advent Christian Village
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, shuttles, river maps and evening entertainment with a benefit concert and speakers.
trips.blurb: With camping atop the bluff overlooking two beautiful rivers, our festival takes place at Suwannee River State Park near Live Oak. The weekend will offer supported paddling options on both the Suwannee and Withlacoochee Rivers, a concert featuring one of Paddle Florida’s favorite musicians, and an educational presentation.

trips.name: 19th Annual Suwannee River Wilderness Trail
trips.route: Madison Blue Spring State Park to Ivey Memorial Park in Branford
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks and evening programs. Two nights at river camps with screened platforms, fans and hot showers.
trips.blurb: Celebrate Florida’s version of spring on its most famous river. The trip spans 63 miles of the scenic Suwannee and a portion of the (northern) Withlacoochee, from Madison Blue Spring to Branford. This section features dozens of clear blue springs perfect for swimming and snorkeling.

trips.name: St. Augustine History Paddle
trips.route: Base camp at Anastasia Island State Park with daily paddles to Salt Run, Princess Place, Castillo de San Marcos, the GTM Research Reserve and Fort Matanzas
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, river maps and evening programs.
trips.blurb: Nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts will find much to appreciate on Florida’s Historic Coast. With miles of protected water, and current and tidal flow to help in any direction, we will paddle to historic sites including downtown Castillo de San Marcos and the Bridge of Lions, Fort Mose, Fort Matanzas National Monument and the St. Augustine Lighthouse, from our home base at Anastasia State Park.
